verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin is a paid autonomous research service, and a service like this could plausibly ship official SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes only web-based report generation, credits and plans, with no mention of any SDK, API or client library. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
